title: Certificate of Appreciation
summary:
A proud milestone for the newly established IEEE RUET AP-S Student Branch Chapter, securing 2nd Runner-Up position at IEEE AP-S PULSE 1.0, held at the University of Rajshahi, while representing both the IEEE RUET AP-S Student Branch Chapter and IEEE RUET Student Branch.

Receiving the certificate from Prof. Karu P. Esselle, Distinguished Professor of Electromagnetic and Antenna Engineering at the University of Technology Sydney, Australia, made this achievement even more memorable. As the chapter has only recently begun its journey, this recognition marks a promising start and reflects our dedication to innovation, teamwork, and excellence in the IEEE community.
organization: Department of ICE University of Rajshahi & IEEE AP-S-MTTS Bangladesh Chapter

summary:

We are hoping for his bright and glorious future.
